title: built a platform for anyone to create and automate their strategies
author: chupamelatorta
selftext:
hello guys,  
after seeing so many post on people making/selling pine strategies and automated indicators, i've been building a platform where any trader can create and deploy their own strategy directly to tradingview.

this is one of the strategy i've made using [the platform](https://algotorma.com/).  
My goal is for any trader to create, deploy and automate their own strategies and bots they want.

Also got the chance to use fable 5 for the debugging and backend development, crazy good!
